What I Do for a Living

I am Avdhut Kulkarni, a Senior Product Designer and Systems Thinker. I work at the intersection of human interface design, design system architecture, and engineering velocity.

My work is grounded in:

  1. First-Principles Product Design: Stripping away decorative noise to reveal the fundamental interaction model.
  2. Design Tokens & Systems: Building scalable, maintainable multi-brand systems that allow design and engineering pods to ship in lockstep.
  3. High-Leverage Tooling: Creating tools, SSGs, and workflows that multiply human output without adding bureaucracy.
